craft_notes: Sthāyin: boundless range. Sanskrit-first: sthāvara kept strange. Rows: 2. Close: stone. Rejected: softening to sentient — killed: plants-and-minerals is the claim. Read aloud: widening cadence.

lines: Grace rebinds the ash; brightness frees the stone.
l4.sanskrit_cite: bījasyāpyatra kāryā ca yojanā kṛpayā guroḥ | yato dīkṣā sudīptatvātsthāvarāṇyapi mocayet
